composition_orient.why: Эталон вертикальной иерархии: headline block → accent rule → hero stat left + caption right → bottom insight pill with icon

reference_role.style: editorial infographic, light cream matte, premium calm
reference_role.layout: left-aligned text columns, generous whitespace, icon circles, rounded pills
reference_role.typography: bold geometric sans all-caps headlines, light pagination, large stat numerals
reference_role.mood: professional education, B2B trust, not playful social
reference_role.content_inspiration: numbered series, stat blocks, list slides — adapted to psychology metaphors

typography_reference.headline: bold sans-serif, ALL CAPS, tight leading
typography_reference.stat: extra-bold sans, accent color, left column

typography_brand_override.headline: Playfair Display 700-800
typography_brand_override.stat: Inter 800 or Bebas Neue Cyrillic for single emphasis

preserve: pagination N/M top-right in muted gray
short horizontal accent rule under headline
large hero stat or key phrase in brand accent color
rounded insight/CTA pills with subtle surface fill
expert portrait on hook and CTA slides
change: sans-only headlines → Playfair Display for headlines
ZOH stats → psychology metaphors (optics, Goya, postcards)
webinar CTA → free 30min EMDR trial session
competitor face → Natalia Morozova portrait from Референсы/
do_not_borrow: ZOH / fitness / VCIOM copy and percentages
competitor webinar date and registration text
thumbnail_test: Slide-01: large Playfair hook + green accent word on cream; portrait silhouette optional right — readable at 200px width
save_test: Slide-05 checklist scale + micro-moments — screenshot-friendly framework card
adaptation_notes: Reference has 9 infographic slides; we compress narrative arc to 6 while keeping slide-02 composition DNA on pain slide and distributing list/stat archetypes across insight/proof/save
